designNotes: Placed in the town bank of the main river (read as the checklist's main channel and beach habitats); the checklist records it in habitats BDF. Jaraqui are detritivores and rarely take a hook; in town they are caught with cast nets, so the game gives them only to the cast net. Their spawning and dispersal runs are not modelled. Occurrence pass: schools run past the town at the start of the rise, December to February, and again less strongly in mid-flood; scarce at high water.
